summary: Gambling.com Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, announcing its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) of shareholders scheduled for May 20, 2026. The filing includes the notice of meeting, proxy cards, and solicitation materials. No special situation is disclosed; this is a routine AGM notice and proxy solicitation. There are no deal terms, transactions, or corporate actions such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes reported. The registrant is the issuer filing routine materials for shareholder voting.
